glyph_origin: According to Shuowen Jiezi, Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 糸 + phonetic 合 – "rich, abundant", perhaps with a reference to precious silk; today it also means "to give". The phonetic component means "to join, to unite", however it is likely unrelated to the original meaning.
